gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
After twenty years of smoking, he finally managed to give it ___.
gaps.explanation: give up = stop/quit (a habit or attempt).

gaps.sentence: A sales rep will follow ___ your enquiry next week.
gaps.explanation: follow up = take further action after something.

gaps.sentence: The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: We've ___ out of milk — could you get some more?
An accident held ___ the traffic for two hours.
Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.
